title: show
summary: Inspect one commit's metadata, per-file change stats, and patch.
purpose: Inspect one commit's metadata, per-file change stats, and patch.

fields.name: sha
fields.description: Hex id of the commit to inspect (4-64 chars). Option-shaped strings and revspecs are rejected.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
A read-only inspection that never changes HEAD, the index, or the working tree (cat-file/show/diff-tree).
The patch is capped at the same 1 MiB limit as diff, and truncation is reported.

errors.when: The sha is missing or is not a commit in this repository.
The sha has an invalid form (reason=invalid_sha), or the request carries a field show does not allow (reason=unknown_field).
This token does not have the read scope.
